departments.name: Tech
departments.tagline: Audio, computing, displays, power, networking and desk hardware

products.name: Halcyon Studio Over-Ear Headphones
products.summary: Closed-back studio monitoring, tuned flat rather than flattering.
products.description: A closed-back reference headphone for people who need to hear what is actually in the mix. The 45mm drivers are tuned deliberately flat, so a muddy low end sounds muddy instead of warm, and the earcups seal well enough to track vocals next to a live monitor.

products.name: Kestrel H40 Wired Headphones
products.summary: The cheap pair you keep in a bag and never worry about.
products.description: Wired, light, and built to be replaced without grief. There is no battery to die, no app to update, and the cable is the part most likely to fail — which is why it unplugs.
bullets: 40mm drivers with a mild bass lift
No battery, no pairing, no app

products.name: Novaline Air Wireless Headphones
products.summary: Forty hours a charge and a physical off switch.
products.description: Bluetooth 5.3 with multipoint, so it holds a laptop and a phone at once and switches without being asked twice. The battery claim is measured at 60% volume with ANC off, which is the number you will actually get.
bullets: Wired fallback when the battery dies

products.name: Orbex Atlas Noise-Cancelling Headphones
products.summary: Adaptive ANC that reads the room instead of guessing.
products.description: Eight microphones sample the cabin around you and re-fit the cancellation curve about two hundred times a second, which is the difference between a plane going quiet and a plane going muffled. Transparency mode passes voices through without the underwater effect.

products.name: Voltaic Drift Wireless Earbuds
products.summary: Eight hours in the ear, thirty more in the case.
products.description: Eight hours on the buds and three further charges in the case, which is a week of commuting between wall sockets. Four sizes of tip in the box, because the seal is what decides whether the bass exists and no single tip fits everyone.
bullets: Each bud works alone for calls

products.name: Signalcraft Monitor One Studio Speaker
products.summary: A single near-field monitor. Buy one, or buy two.
products.description: Sold individually on purpose: a stereo pair is the common case but a centre channel and a mono reference desk are not rare, and forcing everyone to buy two is how you end up with an orphan. Each cabinet is its own amplifier and its own trim control.
bullets: Rear trim controls for HF and LF

products.name: Tessel K65 Mechanical Keyboard
products.summary: 65% layout, hot-swap sockets, gasket mount.
products.description: A 65% board that keeps the arrow cluster, which is the compromise most people actually want. Hot-swap sockets mean switches change without a soldering iron, and the gasket mount takes the hollow sound out of the case.

products.name: Orbex Retro 84 Mechanical Keyboard
products.summary: Dye-sublimated PBT in a colourway that will not fade.
products.description: The legends are dye-sublimated into PBT rather than printed on top of it, so they outlast the switches underneath. Thick 1.5mm caps and a stepped profile give it the sound and the reach of a much older board.

products.name: Tessel Dye-Sub Keycap Set
products.summary: 148 keys, enough for almost any layout you own.
products.description: A 148-key set covering standard, ISO, split-space and 40% kits in one box, so it fits the board you have rather than the board the photograph was taken on. Cherry profile, PBT, dye-sublimated legends.
bullets: Puller and spare novelties in the box

products.name: Meridian Slim Wireless Keyboard
products.summary: Low-profile scissor switches and a year on two AAAs.
products.description: A thin, quiet board for a desk that has to look tidy, with scissor switches that travel far enough to feel deliberate. Two AAA cells run it for roughly a year of normal office use.

products.name: Meridian Contour Wireless Mouse
products.summary: Shaped for a palm grip, silent on the click.
products.description: A right-handed palm-grip shell with dampened switches, so it is usable in a shared room or on a call. The receiver stores inside the battery bay, which is where it survives a house move.

products.name: Voltaic Raptor Gaming Mouse
products.summary: 58 grams without drilling holes in it.
products.description: The weight comes out of the shell wall and the battery, not out of a honeycomb pattern, so it is still a sealed mouse you can use with damp hands. Optical switches remove the double-click failure that kills mechanical ones at about year two.

products.name: Penrose Arc Desk Lamp
products.summary: A weighted base, so it stays where you put it.
products.description: The counterweight is in the base rather than the arm, which means the head holds any angle without a spring fighting you. Colour temperature steps from 2700K to 5000K and the dimmer is stepless rather than three fixed levels.

products.name: Ledger & Co Desk Calculator
products.summary: Twelve digits, solar-assisted, a tilted display.
products.description: A plain desk calculator with keys big enough to hit without looking and a display angled so you read it sitting up. Solar cell with a backup coin cell, so it works on a dim desk and does not die in a drawer.

products.name: Norden 27" 4K IPS Creator Monitor
products.summary: 3840x2160 matte IPS panel, factory calibrated, 90W USB-C single-cable power.
products.description: A 27-inch desktop panel tuned for colour-accurate work without glossy reflections under studio lights. One USB-C cable carries video, four downstream USB-A ports, and up to 90W laptop charging.

products.name: Camber 34" Curved Ultrawide Monitor
products.summary: WQHD 21:9 144Hz panel that replaces a dual-screen bezel gap.
products.description: A gentle 1800R curve keeps the far corners equidistant from your eyes across a long coding or timeline session. Picture-by-picture mode splits two laptops side by side cleanly.
bullets: Built-in KVM switch for two hosts

products.name: Boreal Book 14 Ultrabook Laptop
products.summary: Milled aluminium 14-inch workstation with 16-hour battery and silent fan curve.
products.description: Designed around a 16:10 matte display and full-size ports so you can leave dongles in a drawer. Under light office workloads the fan never spins up.
bullets: Dual Thunderbolt 4, HDMI, full SD reader

products.name: Boreal Slate 11 OLED Tablet
products.summary: High-contrast 11-inch tandem OLED tablet with low-latency magnetic stylus support.
products.description: Built for reading PDFs, annotating schematics, and editing photos away from a desk. Quad speakers handle calls without sounding boxed-in, and the 4096-level pen snaps magnetically to the top edge.

products.name: Signalcraft Desktop DAC & Headphone Amp
products.summary: Zero-hiss balanced DAC and Class-A amp with a weighted machined volume dial.
products.description: Drives everything from sensitive 16-ohm IEMs to stubborn 300-ohm studio headphones cleanly from a single USB-C host connection. Low/high gain toggle sits around back out of accidental reach.

products.name: Halcyon Cardioid USB Condenser Microphone
products.summary: 24-bit cardioid vocal mic with zero-latency monitoring and weighted steel base.
products.description: Tight cardioid pickup rejects keyboard clatter and room echo right off the desk. Touch-less physical mute switch on the rear avoids mechanical thuds on recordings.

products.name: Signalcraft 2x2 XLR Audio Interface
products.summary: Two clean mic preamps (+60 dB gain) in a solid brushed aluminium desk box.
products.description: Handles ribbon mics and guitars without an external inline booster thanks to low-noise preamps. Top-mounted gain halos flash amber before clipping so you set levels in ten seconds.
bullets: 2x XLR / TRS combo inputs with 48V phantom
Balanced TRS monitor outputs + HP amp

products.name: Novaline Waterproof Portable Speaker
products.summary: IP67 dust-and-waterproof woven acoustic cylinder with 18-hour USB-C battery.
products.description: Balanced 360-degree dispersion means it sounds consistent across a kitchen counter or camp table rather than beaming only straight ahead. Pairs two units in stereo over Bluetooth 5.3.
bullets: Braided nylon hang loop + USB-C fast charge

products.name: Meridian 3-in-1 Magnetic Charging Stand
products.summary: Weighted Qi2 aluminum dock charging phone, watch, and earbuds from one cord.
products.description: Heavy die-cast steel inside the base keeps the stand planted when you lift your phone one-handed off the bedside table. Portrait or landscape rotation clicks cleanly.

products.name: Ferrite Thunderbolt 4 12-Port Desk Dock
products.summary: 40 Gbps single-cable desk hub driving dual 4K 60Hz displays and 98W charging.
products.description: Fanless finned aluminium housing keeps a messy monitor-arm setup to one Thunderbolt cable reaching your laptop. Front-facing UHS-II SD reader hits 280 MB/s on camera card offloads.

products.name: Ferrite 7-in-1 Aluminium USB-C Hub
products.summary: Pocket travel dongle with 4K 60Hz HDMI, 100W pass-through, and SD/microSD slots.
products.description: Thickened strain-relief jacket survives daily bending inside a sleeve pocket, and the recessed braided tail resists kinking against the laptop side port.
bullets: Simultaneous SD and microSD card readers

products.name: Ferrite Rugged 2TB External NVMe SSD
products.summary: Finned heatsink enclosure delivering 1,050 MB/s sustained writes without thermal throttling.
products.description: Engineered around deep CNC cooling ribs and IP65 gasket sealing so sustained 4K ProRes dumps never drop speed halfway through a transfer. Ships formatted exFAT for macOS and Windows.
bullets: Includes USB-C to C + USB-A cables

products.name: Plinth 2-Bay Quiet Desktop NAS Enclosure
products.summary: Low-noise RAID-1 private cloud box with dual 2.5 GbE ports and M.2 NVMe cache.
products.description: Designed to live on an open desk rather than a closet: rubber-damped drive rails and a 120mm low-RPM fan keep operation below 21 dBA during Time Machine and photo backups.
bullets: Dual 2.5 GbE RJ45 with link aggregation
Quad-core ARM SoC, 4 GB DDR4 ECC
Supports Docker, SMB, NFS, and WebDAV

products.name: Fathom BE5000 Wi-Fi 7 Router
products.summary: Clean vertical-tower Wi-Fi 7 router with a 2.5G WAN port and local web setup.
products.description: Multi-Link Operation binds 5 GHz and 6 GHz channels simultaneously to cut wireless latency in crowded apartment buildings—without mandatory cloud accounts or subscription paywalls.
bullets: No cloud account required for local UI

products.name: Wayfinder Foldable 3-Axis Smartphone Gimbal
products.summary: Palm-folding 3-axis motorized stabilizer with magnetic clamp and built-in tripod.
products.description: Balances heavy pro phones up to 310 grams without calibrating weights and folds small enough for a coat pocket. Integrated thumbwheel dials smooth focus pulls and zoom ramps.
bullets: Built-in 18 cm extension rod + tripod legs
Gesture trigger for solo timelapse clips

products.name: Orbex Chronos GPS AMOLED Smartwatch
products.summary: Sapphire-glass titanium sports watch with dual-band GPS and 12-day battery.
products.description: Skips subscription paywalls and phone bloat in favor of snappy dual-frequency satellite tracking, continuous optical heart-rate logging, and two weeks away from a charging puck.
bullets: 5 ATM water resistance + offline GPX maps

products.name: Meridian Leaf 7" Glare-Free E-Reader
products.summary: 300 PPI matte Carta display with physical page-turn buttons and zero lockscreen ads.
products.description: An asymmetrical spine places two crisp mechanical page-turn switches right under your thumb while a frontlight blends warm amber down to near-dark for bedtime reading. Accepts EPUB, PDF, and CBZ natively over USB-C.

products.name: Ferrite Dual-Slot UHS-II USB-C Card Reader
products.summary: Simultaneous SD 4.0 and microSD UHS-II transfers up to 312 MB/s over USB 3.2.
products.description: Machined aluminium shell pulls heat out of fast V90 camera cards during back-to-back video offloads. Recessed braided USB-C cable leaves adjacent laptop ports unblocked.
bullets: SD UHS-II + microSD UHS-II read/write concurrently
312 MB/s peak bus bandwidth over 10 Gbps USB-C
Anodised heatsink housing with activity LED
Driverless on macOS, Windows, iPadOS, and Linux

products.name: Halcyon Direct-Drive Studio Turntable
products.summary: Brushless quartz direct-drive deck with switchable phono preamp and USB-C audio out.
products.description: High-torque brushless motor locks 33 1/3 and 45 RPM speeds in under half a rotation, paired with a damped die-cast platter and elliptical moving-magnet cartridge ready for active desk monitors.
bullets: Die-cast aluminium platter with damped rubber mat

products.name: Voltaic Hall-Effect Wireless Controller
products.summary: Zero-drift Hall-effect thumbsticks, hairline-lock triggers, and 1000Hz wireless dongle.
products.description: Contactless magnetic Hall sensors eliminate stick drift across millions of actuator cycles, while short-throw trigger locks swap instantly from analog racing pedals to crisp hair-trigger clicks.
bullets: Two lockable programmable rear metal paddles

specs.Compatibility: PC, Linux, Steam Deck, Android, iOS

products.name: Boreal 360 Acoustic Mesh Smart Speaker
products.summary: Room-filling upward-firing woofer wrapped in acoustic knit with physical mic mute switch.
products.description: Tunes room reflections automatically during setup and links over AirPlay 2, Chromecast, Spotify Connect, and Matter without locking you into a single voice ecosystem.
bullets: Dual-band Wi-Fi 6 + Thread Border Router built in
Stereo-pair two units cleanly on a bookshelf

products.name: Camber 5.5" 4K HDMI On-Camera Field Monitor
products.summary: 1,200-nit daylight-viewable reference monitor with custom 3D LUTs and waveform tools.
products.description: Sharp 1920x1080 touchscreen mounts cleanly onto mirrorless camera cages with tilt arm included, loading Rec.709 LUTs via SD card and passing 4K HDMI signals through cleanly.
bullets: Waveform, vectorscope, false color & focus peaking
NP-F battery plate + USB-C DC power input

products.name: Orbex Meridian Steel 41mm Smartwatch
products.summary: Mirror-finished stainless watch case, micro-woven steel mesh loop, and 7-day battery.
products.description: Sits slim enough to tuck under shirt cuffs all week while tracking sleep stages, VO2 max, NFC tap transit cards, and calendar alerts on a high-brightness edge-to-edge OLED.
bullets: 41mm 316L stainless steel case with sapphire glass
Always-on optical heart rate & SpO2 sensors

products.name: Voltaic Elevated 3-Device Qi2 Desk Stand
products.summary: Weighted matte desk tower holding phone at eye angle while topping up watch and earbuds.
products.description: Elevated stainless spine clears camera bumps smoothly in Standby landscape orientation and hides a recessed fast-charge watch puck behind the main magnetic ring.
bullets: 15W Qi2 magnetic fast phone charging pad
Rear elevated smartwatch fast-charge puck arm
5W padded base bay for wireless earbud cases

products.name: Orbex Magnetic Link & Woven Mesh Strap Set
products.summary: Quick-release pair combining a micro-woven steel mesh loop and ribbed magnetic sport band.
products.description: Standard 22mm and smartwatch-lug adapters swap in three seconds without spring-bar tools. Sealed neodymium links hold tight during runs without pinching wrist hair.
bullets: Includes stainless mesh loop + magnetic ribbed strap

products.name: Orbex Pulse Stealth GPS Fitness Watch
products.summary: Minimalist matte-black anodized aluminum sports watch with crisp sleep and pace metrics.
products.description: Featherweight 27-gram case disappears on long interval runs while logging cadence, recovery readiness, and smartphone notifications cleanly via Bluetooth 5.3.
bullets: 5-satellite GNSS chipset for city pace accuracy
Continuous resting heart rate & recovery tracking
